// Positive control (#5170): the entry's own `emit` only prints. A DIFFERENT file defines an `emit` that
// declares the exit (helper-collision-other.cts.txt) — resolving the call by its bare name across the
// tree would call the verb settled. Helper closures resolve per file and symbol, so it is flagged.
import { output } from './io.cjs';

function emit(payload: Record<string, unknown>, raw: boolean): void {
  output(payload, raw);
}

export function cmdFixtureVerb(raw: boolean): void {
  emit({ valid: false }, raw);
}
